title: Mining Agent Skills from Production Traces
title_zh: 从生产轨迹中挖掘 Agent Skills
abstract_en: Agent skills that record procedural instructions are increasingly mined from execution traces rather than curated by hand. Skill-mining pipelines often use known task outcomes or feedback to guide skill construction. In production, reliable information on whether a run has succeeded may be unavailable. We study how the sampling of execution traces, access to success or failure information, and the form of the mined skills affect downstream task performance. Holding the mining pipeline fixed, we compare six combinations of mining evidence and skill forms. Mining evidence has three levels: successful trajectories only, successes and failures with their outcome labels, or the same mix with labels withheld. Skill form has two types: an ordered workflow plan, or a declarative ontology of entities, states, and policies. We evaluate the mined skills on two enterprise benchmarks, ThinkingBox-Bench and APEX-Agents. Analysis of task-level paired differences shows that the benefits of different configurations of mining evidence and skill forms depend on the enterprise domain. On ThinkingBox-Bench, paired differences show that workflows score better than ontology by 1.7 pp, Goldilocks beats success-only evidence type by 2.4 pp and Goldilocks blind simulating skills learnt without outcomes is worse by 3.1 pp. APEX-Agents shows a moderate preference for ontologies and no clear preference between evidence regimes. Within each domain, task structure related constraints drive uneven performance with mined skills. These findings motivate tailoring meta-skills to the demands of the target tasks rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all approach.
abstract_zh: 本文研究如何从执行轨迹中自动挖掘 Agent Skills，并分析三类挖掘证据与两类技能形式对下游任务性能的影响。证据包括仅成功轨迹、带成功/失败标签的混合轨迹，以及隐藏结果标签的混合轨迹；技能形式包括有序工作流（workflow）和描述实体、状态与策略的声明式本体（ontology）。在 ThinkingBox-Bench 与 APEX-Agents 两个企业级基准上的实验表明，最佳配置取决于目标领域：ThinkingBox-Bench 更偏好 workflow，带结果标签的 Goldilocks 证据优于仅成功轨迹；APEX-Agents 则适度偏好 ontology，且不同证据设置间没有明显差异。任务结构相关约束会导致挖掘技能的性能不均衡，因此应针对目标任务定制 meta-skills，而非采用统一方案。
key_points_zh: 系统比较三种轨迹证据设置与两类技能形式，分别考察结果标签可用性和知识表示方式的影响。
在 ThinkingBox-Bench 上，workflow 比 ontology 高 1.7 个百分点；Goldilocks 证据比仅成功证据高 2.4 个百分点。
在 ThinkingBox-Bench 上，隐藏结果标签的 Goldilocks 技能比带标签版本低 3.1 个百分点，表明结果信息具有重要价值。
APEX-Agents 适度偏好 ontology，且不同证据设置之间没有明确优势，说明领域差异显著。
任务结构相关约束会造成技能效果不均衡，支持面向目标任务定制 meta-skills。

llm_assessment.comment: The paper studies evidence and representation choices for mining reusable procedural skills from traces, but its contribution is primarily comparative rather than a new evolution mechanism.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 论文系统比较了从轨迹挖掘可复用技能时的证据和表示选择，但主要是比较性研究而非新的技能演化机制。
